responsibility: Defines rustc_typeck’s typed diagnostic structs and subdiagnostics for non-structured type-checking and collection errors, giving the crate reusable error payloads, labels, notes, and suggestions that other typeck code instantiates when reporting specific compiler diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `astconv/errors.rs`, this is the crate-wide repository of reusable typeck diagnostic structs used across checking and collection code; it is not the `AstConv`-specific extension impl that decides when AST-to-type conversion errors are emitted.
